attchmntText: Precot Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Precot Limited published its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, in Business Standard and Malai Murasu on November 14, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 13, 2026. Jagran Prakashan Limited also approved its consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. The company reported total revenue from operations of 49,344.16 lakhs and net profit after tax of 4,281.58 lakhs for the quarter. Semac Construction Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. KIC Metaliks Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. The company reported total revenue from operations of 38,160.67 lakhs and net profit after tax of 326.23 lakhs for the quarter.

attchmntText: Precot Limited has informed the Exchange about Demerger
voiceSummary: Precot Limited announced on 13th November 2026 that its Board of Directors granted in-principle approval for the proposed demerger of identified non-core assets. The plan involves transferring these assets, including an investment in Suprem Associates, into a separate resulting company via a Composite Scheme of Arrangement under Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013. The demerged division had a turnover of NIL in the preceding financial year. The rationale includes separating non-core assets to allow management to focus on growth and improving transparency. Existing non-promoter shareholders will receive compensation for shares in the resulting entity, with value determined by an independent valuer. Listing is not sought for the resulting company. The proposal is subject to approvals from the Board, shareholders, creditors, the National Company Law Tribunal, the Stock Exchange, and other regulatory authorities.

attchmntText: Precot Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Precot Limited announced the outcome of its Board meeting held on 13th November 2026. The Board approved the standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The results include a Limited Review Report from statutory auditors VKS Aiyer & Co. For the quarter ended 30th September 2026, standalone revenue from operations was Rs. 27,040.04 Lakhs, with a profit after tax of Rs. 3,026.38 Lakhs. Earnings per share stood at Rs. 25.22. Consolidated revenue from operations for the same period was Rs. 27,040.04 Lakhs. The meeting commenced at 12.00 PM and concluded at 1.05 PM.
